uiElement.title: UI Button Entity
uiElement.description: The 3D/World-Space button entity that the user clicks.

radius.title: Camera Distance
radius.description: How far back the camera stays from this point.

cameraEntity.title: Active Camera
cameraEntity.description: The active camera entity this button should look at.

apiBase.title: API Base URL
apiBase.description: Leave EMPTY to fetch from Supabase only

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Images per request (initial load and each Fetch More click)

splatEntityName.title: Splat Entity Name
splatEntityName.description: Exact name of the GSplat entity

supabaseKey.title: Supabase Publishable Key
supabaseKey.description: Publishable API key from Supabase settings (RLS must be disabled on urls table)

projectName.title: Project Name
projectName.description: Project name to query from Supabase (optional)

orbitMouseButton.title: Orbit Drag Mouse Button
orbitMouseButton.description: Mouse button for camera orbit while search mode is active. 0=Left, 1=Middle, 2=Right. Default: 1 (Middle), same as the measurer.

orbitDragSensitivity.title: Orbit Drag Sensitivity
orbitDragSensitivity.description: Mouse sensitivity for orbit dragging in search mode.

coordinateScale.title: COLMAP Scale
coordinateScale.description: Uniform scale from splat-local units to COLMAP units. Try the measurer's calibrationFactor (e.g. 0.5870968) if the splat was normalized.

coordinateRotation.title: COLMAP Rotation (deg)
coordinateRotation.description: Extra Euler rotation (degrees) applied to the local point before offset. Use only if the normalization reoriented the splat.

coordinateOffset.title: COLMAP Offset
coordinateOffset.description: Translation added after scale+rotation, in COLMAP units. Use if the splat was recentered relative to COLMAP.

useServerCalibration.title: Use Server Calibration
useServerCalibration.description: Send raw world coords and let the server's calibrated transform map them to COLMAP. Enable after sqCal.compute().

viewFilterEnabled.title: View Angle Filter
viewFilterEnabled.description: Bias returned photos toward your current viewing angle (needs camera pose sent to / returned by the API).

maxViewAngle.title: Max View Angle (deg)
maxViewAngle.description: Only keep photos whose viewing direction is within this many degrees of your current view. Larger = looser.

enableOrbitMode.title: Enable Orbit Mode
enableOrbitMode.description: Toggle whether the user can click/touch and drag to orbit around active waypoints.

enableHoverAnimation.title: Enable Hover Animation
enableHoverAnimation.description: Toggle the idle floating/swaying animation when at a waypoint or at home base.

safetyCushion.title: Collision Safety Cushion
safetyCushion.description: How many meters to stop the camera BEFORE hitting a surface during orbit raycasts.

minCollisionRadius.title: Hard Core Safety Radius
minCollisionRadius.description: The absolute minimum distance allowed from the waypoint center.

fpsToggleKey.title: FPS Activation Key
fpsToggleKey.description: Key constant name from the PlayCanvas API (e.g., KEY_SPACE, KEY_F)

enableFPSMode.title: Enable FPS Controller
enableFPSMode.description: If checked, the player can use the FPS hotkey to run around.

enableIdleWalking.title: Enable Idle Walking
enableIdleWalking.description: If checked, the user can walk in IDLE mode when FPS Mode is disabled.

cameraEntity.title: Player Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: The primary camera entity that will be rotation-locked during screenshot selection.

targetEntity.description: The entity to enable if touch is detected

buttonPosition.title: Button Position
buttonPosition.description: Where to place the screenshot button

cameraEntity.title: Player Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: The primary camera entity (optional - locks rotation during capture)

pathNodes.title: Path Nodes
pathNodes.description: Drag and drop the entities that form the tour loop.

idleDelay.title: Inactivity Delay (Sec)
idleDelay.description: How many seconds of absolute silence before the tour starts.

tourSpeed.title: Tour Speed Modifier
tourSpeed.description: How fast the camera moves along the spline path.

transitionSpeed.title: Transition Lerp Speed
transitionSpeed.description: How smoothly the camera blends onto the spline track when entering the tour.

autoFocusWaypoints.title: Auto Focus Waypoints
autoFocusWaypoints.description: If checked, the camera dynamically looks at the closest scene waypoint while moving.

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: The primary camera used for world-space projection and depth calculation.

calibrationFactor.title: Calibration Factor
calibrationFactor.description: Multiplier applied to raw distances. Input value is always in meters. When Imperial Formatting is enabled, the calibrated meter value is automatically converted to feet/inches.

fontAsset.title: UI Font Asset
fontAsset.description: The runtime font asset used to generate the floating world-space text.

previewLaserMaterial.title: Live Preview Laser Material
previewLaserMaterial.description: Dedicated material for the real-time preview line before clicking.

pickingLayerName.title: Picking Layer Name
pickingLayerName.description: The layer where your Gaussian Splats or meshes exist. The tool will scan this layer for clicks.

renderingLayerName.title: Placed Elements Layer Name
renderingLayerName.description: The layer where PERMANENT measurement pins, lasers, and text will be drawn.

previewLaserLayerName.title: Preview Laser Layer Name
previewLaserLayerName.description: The layer where the real-time live preview laser line before clicking will be drawn.

reticleLayerName.title: Hover Reticle Layer Name
reticleLayerName.description: The layer where the real-time tracking hover reticle primitive will be drawn.

textOffset.title: Text Position Offset
textOffset.description: Adjusts the directional spacing to push the text label up and away from the laser wires.

enableKeyboardShortcuts.title: Enable Keyboard Hotkeys
enableKeyboardShortcuts.description: If unchecked, keyboard keys (G, Ctrl, Shift) will not control the measuring state.

enableImperialFormatting.title: Enable Imperial Formatting
enableImperialFormatting.description: If checked, measurements will be formatted to Feet, Inches, and fractions (American Tape Measure format).

useImperialSymbols.title: Use Quotes (' ") Symbols
useImperialSymbols.description: If checked, uses ' for feet and " for inches instead of "ft" and "in".

enableUndo.title: Enable Undo
enableUndo.description: Allows removing the last placed point via Ctrl+Z or UI button.

enableImperialFractions.title: Enable Imperial Fractions
enableImperialFractions.description: If checked, imperial measurements will display fractions (e.g. 11/32). If unchecked, rounds to nearest inch.

useHoldMode.title: Use Hold Mode (Snap/Delete)
useHoldMode.description: If checked, the Snapping Toggle and Delete Mode hotkeys require holding the key. Release reverts the state. If unchecked (default), they work as single-press toggles.

hotkeyToggleMeasure.title: Hotkey: Toggle Measure
hotkeyToggleMeasure.description: Key name to toggle measuring mode on/off. Default: KEY_G

hotkeyEscape.title: Hotkey: Exit/Escape
hotkeyEscape.description: Key name to exit/deactivate measuring mode. Default: KEY_ESCAPE

hotkeyNewChain.title: Hotkey: New Chain
hotkeyNewChain.description: Key name to start a new measurement chain. Default: KEY_SHIFT

hotkeyUndo.title: Hotkey: Undo
hotkeyUndo.description: Key name for undo (combined with Ctrl/Cmd). Default: KEY_Z

hotkeyDeleteMode.title: Hotkey: Delete Mode
hotkeyDeleteMode.description: Key name to toggle or hold-activate deletion mode. Default: KEY_ALT

hotkeyToggleSnapping.title: Hotkey: Toggle Snapping
hotkeyToggleSnapping.description: Key name to toggle or hold-activate snapping. Default: KEY_CONTROL

orbitMouseButton.title: Orbit Drag Mouse Button
orbitMouseButton.description: Mouse button index for camera orbit drag while measuring. 0 = Left, 1 = Middle, 2 = Right. Default: 1 (Middle).

orbitDragSensitivity.title: Orbit Drag Sensitivity
orbitDragSensitivity.description: Mouse sensitivity for orbit dragging. Matches cameraManager orbitSensitivity by default.

toggleModeButton.title: Toggle Mode Button
toggleModeButton.description: The UI button to activate and deactivate measuring mode.

newChainButton.title: New Chain Button
newChainButton.description: The UI button to start a new measurement chain.

toggleSnappingButton.title: Toggle Snapping Button
toggleSnappingButton.description: The UI button to enable or disable point snapping.

springStiffness.title: Spring Stiffness
springStiffness.description: Stiffness of the pop-in spring animation. Higher values mean faster spring response.

springDamping.title: Spring Damping
springDamping.description: Damping of the pop-in spring animation. Higher values reduce bounce/oscillation.

enableAnimations.title: Enable Animations
enableAnimations.description: If unchecked, the sub-menu buttons will appear and disappear instantly.

timeScale.title: Animation Time Scale
timeScale.description: Multiplier for animation delta-time. Increase to make animations faster.

springMass.title: Spring Mass
springMass.description: The mass of the simulated spring. Higher values make the button pop heavier with more lag/inertia.

deleteModeButton.title: Delete Mode Button
deleteModeButton.description: UI Button to toggle point deletion mode.

undoButton.title: Undo Button
undoButton.description: UI Button to undo the last measurement.
